character.description: right-facing native 32x20 friendly sea-turtle taxi with broad olive shell platform, four attached mint flippers and navy driver cap

paddle.action: right-facing two-frame swimming loop at strict scale lock: keep the head, eye, cap, shell platform and body center fixed; in frame 2 alternate the four attached flippers by one to two logical pixels while preserving the same shell footprint and baseline; seamless alternating loop; no passenger, translation, resizing, detached parts, bubbles or effects

style: native 32x20 hard-edged pixel art with large countable logical pixels, one-pixel dark teal outline, flat clusters and a shared limited olive-mint-navy palette; preserve the accepted turtle base identity exactly and animate only the flippers
